name: repo_manager
description: Repository-governance skill for architecture-aware inspection, impact analysis, safe implementation, validation, promotion, and compiler-driven automation of repeated repository workflows.

human_task_content_compiler.description: Compiles canonical planning/content sources into reviewable task projections and approved declarative manifests using deterministic recipe classification and fail-closed source binding.

coreRules: preserve architecture unless migration is explicitly authorized
produce dependency and impact maps for material changes
never delete materially destructive artifacts without approval
automate mechanics and surface semantic decisions
prefer generic invariants and manifests over per-unit runtime cases
verify deployment against the exact merged commit
